paper: AlphaAgent: LLM-Driven Alpha Mining with Regularized Exploration to Counteract Alpha Decay
headline_strategy: LLM-generated U.S. factor pool feeding a learned next-period return score and a Qlib long-only top-50/drop-5 portfolio
evaluated_component: all six source-disclosed U.S. factor expressions in factor_zoo/us_factors.csv at the paper mechanism snapshot
component_selection_reason: The exact five anonymous generated features used by the matching author run are unrecoverable. Using all six paper-snapshot U.S. expressions avoids outcome-based factor selection and is the strongest source-disclosed pool that can be transferred without claiming the full mining loop.

monthly_adapter.inputs: JKP monthly abs(prc), prc_high, prc_low, and tvol; previous-month close is the disclosed proxy for unavailable monthly open
monthly_adapter.formula_normalization: each literal formula is cross-sectionally percentile-ranked to [-1,1] in the formation-date top-1,000 universe
monthly_adapter.learning: fixed ridge=1 rolling 120-month linear score, requiring 24 prior formation months and using only realized outcomes from earlier formations
monthly_adapter.warmup: cash until 24 prior formation months exist; all 305 common return months remain in the path
monthly_adapter.portfolio: common value-weighted long-short deciles because this evaluates a score component, not the unrecoverable native fitted model/portfolio
monthly_adapter.costs: common 10 bp one-way primary plus fixed sensitivity cases
monthly_adapter.missing_returns: common zero primary and adverse-100 sensitivity without reranking

preserved: all six source expressions without JKP-performance selection
learned combination using earlier outcomes only
U.S. equities and next-period return objective
adapted: daily bars to monthly JKP bars
ridge for unavailable exact LightGBM feature mapping
common decile portfolio for the score-only partial
not_claimed: the matching author run's anonymous five-factor identity
